expected_level_description: You can: - file, find, and track records correctly - protect records from loss or unauthorised access
You can: - explain why records are kept for set periods and then destroyed or archived - follow procedures for storing and moving records
You can: - follow the organisation's rules for handling personal and health information - recognise and report a data breach or near miss
You can: - keep confidential information safe and share it only when you are allowed to - ask for advice when you are not sure
You can: - follow office procedures for filing, ordering, and data entry - keep accurate records of your own work
You can: - create and edit documents, emails, and simple spreadsheets - store and share files in the right place
You can: - explain why accurate health data matters for care and planning - record data accurately and report errors
